rule: Batch 52 prerequisite (jobs/c3/batch52.yaml part C, Dan's words): "the gate passes on 60 main-test scenes; the layer is fixed by the published rule (earliest layer where both readers switch >= 0.3, sweeping every 4th layer)". As computed: the gate = X0's (unedited org accuracy under X0's top-token read >= 0.80 for both readers) on the first 60 main-test scenes in scene order; the sweep = the whole change at the bridge word on 60 dev scenes (51.6's split: random.Random(0).sample of the eligible scenes) at L2, L6, ..., L50; the layer = the earliest where both readers' switch rates are >= 0.3 (point estimates, EPS 1e-9); none: "the bridge word does not redirect the lookup at any layer on Lightning" and the column is cancelled
scenes: gate: the first 60 main-test scenes in scene order; sweep: X0's eligible scenes (scene order), dev = random.Random(0).sample of 60 (51.6's split); test = the first 200 eligible not in dev (recorded for the coverage runs, not read here)
step1: Δ_l = h_S - h_O at the bridge word, every layer of LAYERS4 from one forward of O and one of S; the whole Δ_l added at l on O (AddRows); both readers; X0's chat read

order.scenes: sorted by scene id (build_cases); the eligible ones in that order, the first N_ITEMS kept; the kept ids in gate.json 'order'
order.competence: per scene, reader and rendering: org and alt generated together (one batch of 2 rows), then each one's read alone (a batch of 1)
order.delta: per scene: one unbatched forward of org and of alt
order.reads: per scene, reader and layer: the unedited row, then the arms in their fixed order (whole; per dictionary, k, fit: no_part, no_rand; with --atom-slices 47.1's parts after J++'s), in batches of at most 16 rows (BJ_SUITE_BATCH)
order.step1: per dev case and reader: the unedited row, then the whole change at each layer of LAYERS4 in order, in batches of at most 16 rows
